messages.subject: Questions about besag and besagproper
parts:
Hi all,

When I fit the interaction term of Bayesian spatio-temporal interaction model Ⅳ, I chose "besag" for the spatial effect, but the model failed. I changed it to "besagproper", and the model works normally, but I don't know if this is correct.

Thanks!

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Questions about besag and besagproper
parts:
you need to add scale.model=T, as otherwise, one can construct singular
models based on the data-values. otherwise, you introduce near
singularilty, and you might need to adjust the model to not run into
numerical singularity
